name: stri_omit_na
title: Omit missing values from a character vector

origin.description: Alias of stri_remove_na. Returns x with missing values removed.
origin.details: This is stri_remove_na. Empty strings are kept.

translation.description: Alias of stri_remove_na. Returns x with missing values removed.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, or a list of strings and stringi._na.NA.

translation.details: The same function as stri_remove_na. NA is dropped and an empty string is kept.
translation.value: A list of the kept strings.
translation.example:
from stringi._na import NA
from stringi.utils import stri_omit_na
print(stri_omit_na(['a', NA, '', 'b']))
